SELECT batter,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_runs), 2) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_runs) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS players_with_1000_runs
FROM (
    SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY batter
    HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(total_runs) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT match_ids) FROM deliveries

SELECT 
    batter,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_runs)) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY batter
    HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000
) AS subquery

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wide', 'noball', 'no-ball')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_ids, batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(total_runs) FROM deliveries WHERE over BETWEEN 0 AND 5

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS total_runs
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 15 AND 19
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH batter_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    batter,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type != 'wides' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE extras_type != 'wides' OR extras_type IS NULL
  GROUP BY batter
  HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
)
SELECT 
  batter,
  ROUND(CAST(runs AS REAL) / legal_balls * 100, 2) AS strike_rate
FROM batter_stats
WHERE legal_balls > 0
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH legal_balls AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    COUNT(*) AS balls,
    SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs_conceded
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'no_balls') 
     OR extras_type IS NULL
     OR extras_type = ''
  GROUP BY bowler
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
),
bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    bowler,
    runs_conceded,
    balls,
    CAST(balls AS REAL) / 6.0 AS overs,
    CAST(runs_conceded AS REAL) / (CAST(balls AS REAL) / 6.0) AS economy
  FROM legal_balls
)
SELECT bowler, economy
FROM bowler_stats
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.season, d.batting_team, SUM(d.total_runs) AS total_runs
FROM deliveries d
JOIN matches m ON d.match_ids = m.id
GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
HAVING total_runs = (
    SELECT MAX(runs)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(d2.total_runs) AS runs
        FROM deliveries d2
        JOIN matches m2 ON d2.match_ids = m2.id
        WHERE m2.season = m.season
        GROUP BY d2.batting_team
    ) AS season_runs
)
ORDER BY m.season

SELECT batter, 
       SUM(batsman_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT match_ids) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_ids) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.batting_team, SUM(d.total_runs) AS second_innings_total
FROM deliveries d
JOIN matches m ON d.match_ids = m.id
WHERE d.inning = 2 AND d.batting_team = m.winner
GROUP BY d.match_ids, d.batting_team
ORDER BY second_innings_total DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed
    FROM deliveries
    WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN toss_winner = winner AND toss_decision = 'field' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM matches
WHERE winner IS NOT NULL

WITH season_2023 AS (
  SELECT * FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_played AS (
  SELECT team1 AS team FROM season_2023
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team2 AS team FROM season_2023
),
team_counts AS (
  SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
  FROM team_played
  GROUP BY team
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
),
team_wins AS (
  SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM season_2023
